questions.question: What is P(π)?
questions.explanation: P(π) applies e^{iπ} = -1 to |1⟩, which is exactly what the Z gate does.

questions.question: What does the S gate equal?
questions.explanation: S = P(π/2). It applies a phase of e^{iπ/2} = i to |1⟩.

questions.question: Why is the T gate important?
options: It's needed for universal quantum computation with H and CNOT
questions.explanation: The gate set {H, T, CNOT} is universal — any quantum computation can be approximated using just these three gates.
